title: Renon — occlusion map (visibility per scan position)
description: Occlusion/visibility analysis (CANOPy concept, GeoSense Freiburg) on the synthetic HELIOS++ scan of the Renon inventory, 6 TLS positions. Coloured by the number of positions from which a point received returns: RED = seen from only ONE position (one-sided, prone to occlusion), GREEN = freely visible from several. This shows where a single-scan inventory is blind — the geometric core of the 'single-scan occlusion' limitation. On the synthetic scan it is the clean test case (positions and truth known). CANOPy itself is not (yet) public; the concept is implemented here in the spirit of the suite (scripts/occlusion_map.py).
